project: Context-Aware Mobile App Privacy Risk Analyzer

Calculator.description: Standard utility app for numerical and arithmetic calculations.

android.permission.INTERNET.reason: An offline utility does not require external network communication; often indicates ad-trackers or covert analytics.

android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.reason: GPS coordinate tracking is completely anomalous for a calculation tool.

android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATIO.reason: Network location tracking is unnecessary for basic arithmetic.

android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.reason: Calculator does not have social functionality; indicates address book harvesting.

android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.reason: Reading general user storage exposes private documents, photos, and files.

android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAG.reason: Arbitrary external storage write access can modify or corrupt shared files.

android.permission.CAMERA.reason: Camera sensor access is suspicious unless specifically marketed as OCR/Math solver.

android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.reason: Microphone recording permission creates severe eavesdropping risks.

android.permission.READ_SMS.reason: Access to SMS allows reading sensitive 2FA OTP tokens and private messages.

android.permission.SEND_SMS.reason: Ability to send SMS can incur financial fraud via premium-rate messaging.

android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE.reason: Access to IMEI, phone number, and carrier state allows persistent hardware fingerprinting.

Flashlight.description: Utility application intended to toggle the camera flash or screen illumination.

android.permission.INTERNET.reason: A torch app should operate purely locally without outbound internet transmission.

android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.reason: Fine GPS location is entirely unrelated to torch functionality; classic sign of location ad-monetization.

android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATIO.reason: Coarse network location tracking is incongruent with flashlight hardware toggle.

android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.reason: Accessing user contact records is malicious/excessive for a flashlight.

android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.reason: Reading files from external shared memory is unnecessary for torch operation.

android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAG.reason: Flashlight utility has no justification to write or modify user media.

android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.reason: Microphone recording permission in a flashlight is a high-confidence spyware indicator.

android.permission.READ_SMS.reason: Reading SMS messages presents severe identity and credential interception hazards.

android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE.reason: Reading cellular hardware identifiers for device tracking and profiling.

Navigation.description: Mapping, routing, and turn-by-turn geolocation guidance application.

android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.reason: Reading full contact list is sensitive; unless integrating address-book destination picker, it leaks social graphs.

android.permission.READ_SMS.reason: Reading SMS messages is completely anomalous for satellite navigation.

android.permission.SEND_SMS.reason: Sending SMS without explicit user initiation presents toll fraud hazards.

android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.reason: Audio recording capability outside interactive voice-search represents acoustic surveillance risk.

android.permission.CAMERA.reason: Camera access is non-standard unless AR navigation or dashcam functionality is actively utilized.

android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG.reason: Access to incoming/outgoing call history has zero functional relevance to routing.

Social Media.description: Platforms for social networking, content sharing, and community engagement.

android.permission.READ_SMS.reason: Reading full SMS messages is unnecessary for modern social platforms using SMS Retriever API.

android.permission.SEND_SMS.reason: Social media applications should not trigger direct SMS dispatch.

android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG.reason: Call logs represent private telephony communications not required for social feeds.

android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW.reason: Displaying overlays on top of other applications presents clickjacking and credential harvesting risks.

android.permission.PROCESS_OUTGOING_CALL.reason: Intercepting or rerouting outgoing phone calls is dangerous.

Messaging.description: Instant messaging, chat, VoIP, and communication applications.

android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOC.reason: Persistent background GPS tracking is anomalous for text/voice messaging apps.

android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG.reason: Access to native cellular call logs is non-essential unless operating as default phone dialer.

android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW.reason: Overlay capabilities can be abused for phishing overlays.

android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKA.reason: Messaging apps requesting arbitrary package installations can act as malware droppers.

Banking/Finance.description: Digital banking, fintech, payments, cryptocurrency, and financial management tools.

android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.reason: Microphone recording is anomalous for banking applications and introduces eavesdropping risk.

android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW.reason: High-confidence Banking Trojan vector: Overlay permissions allow stealing PINs, passwords, and banking credentials.

android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKA.reason: Dropper functionality is completely forbidden in verified financial platforms.

android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG.reason: Access to incoming/outgoing telephony call records is unrelated to financial transactions.

android.permission.READ_SMS.reason: Modern banking apps should use SMS Retriever or User Consent API rather than broad READ_SMS.

android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.reason: High-precision continuous GPS is generally excessive; approximate location suffices for fraud defense.

Health/Fitness.description: Activity tracking, workouts, health telemetry, step counters, and wellness monitors.

android.permission.READ_SMS.reason: Reading SMS messages is completely anomalous for exercise and health metrics.

android.permission.SEND_SMS.reason: Fitness applications should not send unauthorized SMS messages.

android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG.reason: Telephony call logs are irrelevant to physical activity and wellness tracking.

android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.reason: Reading complete address book is unnecessary unless user explicitly searches for workout buddies.

Games.description: Mobile games, entertainment titles, and interactive gaming software.

android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.reason: Games harvesting phone address books without social invite features leak personal contact lists.

android.permission.READ_SMS.reason: Reading SMS in gaming apps is a recognized toll fraud and credential theft indicator.

android.permission.SEND_SMS.reason: Direct SMS transmission from games has historically been exploited for premium toll fraud.

android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.reason: Fine GPS location tracking is anomalous unless the game explicitly features augmented reality / geo-location (e.g. Pokemon GO).

android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.reason: Recording microphone audio without in-game voice chat features is suspicious.

android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG.reason: Games have zero legitimate need to inspect user telephony history.

Camera/Photo.description: Photography, image editing, filters, scanner, and video recording apps.

android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.reason: Access to address book contacts is unrelated to photo capture or editing.

android.permission.READ_SMS.reason: Reading text messages is completely anomalous for a camera or image editor.

android.permission.SEND_SMS.reason: Camera applications have no justification for sending SMS messages.

android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG.reason: Photo utilities should never access telephony call logs.

android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOC.reason: Background geolocation tracking is unnecessary; geotagging only requires foreground location.

Music/Video.description: Media players, music streaming, podcast clients, and audio/video playback tools.

android.permission.READ_SMS.reason: Reading user SMS messages is completely anomalous for media playback.

android.permission.SEND_SMS.reason: Media players should never dispatch SMS messages.

android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.reason: Reading contacts is unnecessary for standard audio/video listening.

android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.reason: GPS coordinate tracking is non-standard for music and video playback tools.

android.permission.CAMERA.reason: Camera sensor access is suspicious for audio/video playback.

android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG.reason: Access to phone call history has no functional relevance to audio players.

Shopping.description: E-commerce, online marketplaces, retail shopping, and delivery tracking apps.

android.permission.READ_SMS.reason: Shopping apps should utilize modern SMS User Consent API rather than full READ_SMS.

android.permission.SEND_SMS.reason: Direct SMS sending from shopping apps can indicate covert subscription fraud.

android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.reason: Continuous microphone access is excessive for browsing retail items.

android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG.reason: Call logs are irrelevant to browsing or ordering merchandise.

android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOC.reason: Continuous background GPS is excessive; delivery tracking only requires foreground checks.

Productivity.description: Office suites, note-taking, calendars, file management, and personal organization.

android.permission.READ_SMS.reason: Reading SMS messages is anomalous for office document or note tools.

android.permission.SEND_SMS.reason: Productivity applications should not send unauthorized SMS messages.

android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG.reason: Telephony call logs have no functional relevance to document processing.

android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.reason: High-precision GPS tracking is anomalous for general productivity software.

Education.description: Learning platforms, courses, academic tools, language learning, and study aids.

android.permission.READ_SMS.reason: Reading SMS messages is completely anomalous for educational tools.

android.permission.SEND_SMS.reason: Education applications should not transmit background SMS.

android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG.reason: Call log access is completely unjustified in an academic application.

android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.reason: GPS location tracking is non-standard for educational and study applications.

dangerous_combinations.name: Local Storage Exfiltration Risk
dangerous_combinations.description: App can read arbitrary private files, documents, or photos from storage and transmit them to external internet servers.

dangerous_combinations.name: Modern Media Library Exfiltration
dangerous_combinations.description: App can access sensitive personal photos and graphics via Scoped Storage APIs and exfiltrate them externally.

dangerous_combinations.name: Address Book Harvesting Risk
dangerous_combinations.description: App can read full contact names, emails, phone numbers, and exfiltrate the user's social graph over the network.

dangerous_combinations.name: Covert Microphone Eavesdropping Risk
dangerous_combinations.description: App possesses both microphone recording and outbound networking, allowing ambient audio streaming without visual UI indicators.

dangerous_combinations.name: SMS & 2FA OTP Interception Risk
dangerous_combinations.description: App can intercept incoming two-factor authentication (2FA) one-time passwords and transmit them to remote command-and-control servers.

dangerous_combinations.name: Covert Visual Surveillance Risk
dangerous_combinations.description: Ability to capture camera frames combined with internet transmission allows unauthorized image/video streaming.

dangerous_combinations.name: Telephony Call Log Exfiltration
dangerous_combinations.description: Call records containing timestamps, call durations, and caller phone numbers can be transmitted externally.

dangerous_combinations.name: Continuous Location Exfiltration Risk
dangerous_combinations.description: High-precision GPS coordinates can be streamed to cloud analytics or third-party ad brokers to establish physical movement patterns.

dangerous_combinations.name: Local Network / Hardware Perimeter Tracking
dangerous_combinations.description: App can scan nearby Wi-Fi APs and BSSIDs to fingerprint the user's home or office physical location without GPS permissions.
